verdict.rationale: Airbyte's schema-change-management docs explicitly state you can specify per-connection how Airbyte should handle schema changes in the source, indicating a policy-driven propagation mechanism rather than silent breakage. This directly matches the story, though depth is limited to a single doc page without independent hands-on validation of edge cases. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of schema-change policy behavior in practice, detail on the specific policy options (e.g., auto-propagate vs pause vs ignore) and how conflicts/breaking changes are surfaced to the engineer.
